source_text: Fratres adorant; non cognoscunt. Tentat eos; Simeon ligatur. Conscientia peccati redit.
pass_a_gloss: Brothers worship; not they-recognize. He-tests them; Simeon is-bound. Conscience of-sin returns.
pass_b_english: [[Brothers bow; they do not recognize him >> Bible:Genesis 42:6-8]]. He tests them; Simeon is bound. Conscience of sin returns.
